name: @penguinharness/openskill-rsi-toolkit
description: OpenSkill RSI: retrieve independent knowledge, refine reusable skills with virtual tests, freeze the final library, then evaluate native Project Benchmarks.

penguin.description_zh: OpenSkill RSI：检索独立知识，以虚拟测试反馈修订可复用技能，冻结最终技能库后评测项目内的 Benchmark。支持当前 Harbor 任务和 GDPevo 领域 Train/Test 包。
penguin.short_description: OpenSkill RSI Toolkit: learn skills through research and virtual tests.
penguin.short_description_zh: OpenSkill RSI 工具包：通过检索与虚拟测试学习技能。

quick_start.prompt: Use openskill-rsi-toolkit to run OpenSkill on a published Benchmark in this Project with a fresh Target and the current model, including a baseline comparison; ask which Benchmark if unspecified.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 使用 openskill-rsi-toolkit，以当前模型和新建 Target 在本项目已发布的 Benchmark 上运行 OpenSkill 并比较基线；若未指定 Benchmark，请先询问。

penguin.title: OpenSkill RSI Toolkit
